VS.

full_judgment: 8. The plaintiff only examined himself as PW 1 and stated that he purchased the suit property from one Mahmudun Nabi Chowdhury by a registered kabala Ext. 1 and his name has been mutated and Khatian has been prepared in his name which is marked as Ext. 3 and he also paid rent vide Ext 4 the rent receipts. He further stated that on 15-12-81 he received a notice from the office of the Executive Engineer, Abandoned House. PWD Division stating that the suit property is not an abandoned property and the said notice is marked as Ext 5. He further stated that he filed Title Suit No. 131/82 for a declaration that the suit property is not an abandoned property and that suit was decreed on 11-1-87 and the said decree is marked as Ext. 6 He further stated that even after getting the said decree the defendants did not vacate the suit premises and for that this suit has been filed for eviction. The plaintiff further stated that it is not a fact he is not a citizen of Bangladesh or that he left Bangladesh or that he left Bangladesh before the war of liberation or his son and family were not here and it is not correct that the defendant did not know about the Title Suit No. 131 of 1982 and he stated that the document dated 4-10-80 in favour of the defendant No. 4 is illegal and plaintiff is not bound by the said deed and by which his right has not been lost. In cross-examination the plaintiff stated that it is not a fact that the suit land has been declared as abandoned property by notification. The defendant No. 4 was not a party in OC, Suit No. 131 of 1982 and he does not know whether the Government preferred an appeal against the decree of the suit and it is stated that it is not a fact that the defendant is not aware of the said Title Suit No. 131 of 1982 and he did not file any application for cancellation of the sale deed dated 4-10-80 and he stated that he filed OC Suit No. 139 of 1982 and in that suit he stated that he went to perform Hajj on 25-11-71 and he further stated that he did not state that he went for performing Hajj in January, 1971. He denied that he did not come to Bangladesh on 10-9-76. He does not know about the possession being given to Sena Kallayan Sangstha on 14-12-72. He went to Settlement Office but he did not file any suit for mutation and he came to know about the possession of the Sena Kallayan Sangstha at the time of institution of OC Suit No. 139 of 1982. He further stated in cross-examination that it is not a fact that he did not manage the suit land from 16-12-71 and he also was not aware of value of the suit land which will be not more than 3 lacs. He knew that the property was sold to Sena Kallayan Sangstha on 4-10-80, it is not a fact that the defendants were in possession from 14-12-72 and and he was not cross-examined by the Government defendant No. 1
